interview.secured: Day secured means you completed your daily task (reading 10 pages) and locked in your progress for the day.
interview.freeze: The app never explained what a freeze is on the screens I saw.
interview.selfReported: The app never explained what self-reported means on the screens I saw.
interview.tomorrow: 8. I enjoyed tracking my reading habit and seeing the streak counter motivate me to continue.

goals.text: Open the challenge the app shows you, join it, log 10 pages and finish with Done. When the app asks, choose Keep it private.
